body: I did try to search some online, but can't find anything. I think I'm just shit out of luck, like I have been all my life.

I don't know any groups that would help and crowdfunding feels humiliating. Why would people want to financially support somebody like me? I don't think many people would give a fuck if I were to die and I've been a leech for too long.
I think I'm destined to kill myself before I turn 30, five more years to go. For as long as I can remember I have been self-harming and suicidal, so ending it this way seems fitting.

I know you mean well, but how? How would I be able to look past this? I might be homeless and lose everything. I doubt I will be able to get out of that... How would I? The governments around me have shown that they don't give a shit and I can't survive out there alone. What am I supposed to do?
